segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one who had spent years over-stripping it, report the tonic gives a gentle but deep clean that reduces congestion and whiteheads without making oiliness worse.
segments.dry: The one reviewer who states she has dry skin reports visibly smaller pores after a week, though she still follows up with a moisturizer, particularly given her desert climate.
segments.combination: The one reviewer who identifies as having combination skin reports it feels balanced, brighter, and clean without residue.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including several managing rosacea, overwhelmingly report no irritation or redness; one reviewer, however, reports the tonic caused redness that persisted across repeated uses.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s and 60s report brighter, calmer, more youthful-looking skin, with one noting her dermatologist remarked it looked younger than in a prior visit.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who describes her skin as normal reports it cleanses without drying it out.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers report their skin looking younger or fresher, and lines appearing softer, after adding the tonic to a fuller routine; one reviewer's dermatologist remarked her skin looked younger than in a prior visit. This is not the focus of most reviews.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers overwhelmingly report the tonic cleanses and tones without stripping or drying the skin, several contrasting it favorably with other toners that left their skin feeling taut and dry; no reviewer in this set reports it causing dryness.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several managing rosacea, report calmer skin with no irritation or redness, and a few describe a visible reduction in redness with continued use. One reviewer, however, reports the tonic itself caused redness that persisted across repeated applications.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports a noticeable reduction in age spots alongside improved skin texture; another notes her skin tone evened out. This is not a focus of most reviews.
concerns.blemishes: A couple of reviewers report fewer whiteheads and breakouts with regular use, including one who uses it to manage congestion from wearing a mask for work; this is not a focus of most reviews.

extraits.titre: I forgot that this is what toner can do
extraits.texte: I used to use toner pretty religiously and for some reason, in my mid or late twenties, I stopped. Maybe I thought I was drying out my skin. Since my teenage years, I've had incredibly oily skin and I thought that by trying to mattify it constantly, I was actually making my skin produce more oil and that I should actually just focus on moisturizing my skin instead of stripping it of its oils. By my thirties, I still had the same oily skin, but I also had congested pores and perpetual white heads in the crevices around and under my nose. My skin was often easily inflamed – redness brought on by hot showers, exercise, and more. I bought this face tonic during Ursa Major's Black Friday sale (it's normally far pricier than any other toner I've used). I've been using it for about two months and my skin feels less irritated/congested and my whiteheads are mostly not an issue anymore. It feels like it's a very gentle exfoliation – one I can use multiple times a day. I wear a mask for 8 hours a day at work and to prevent breakouts, I swipe this onto my face during my one break and it's helped control acne formation. I use this product with the Vitamin C serum and the Golden Hour Recovery cream.

I have been using this toner for three months now and it has greatly reduced the red nose and cheeks I've had all my adult life from Rosecea. I am so amazed how great my skin looks and feels. I use the Golden Hour Face Cream after the toner every day and all I can say is this combination has made the skin on my face very, very happy! No more, red cheeks, nose and breakouts and lines are greatly softened. I buy the toner and face cream two at a time so I always have them. Give this product a try. You won't be sorry.
In one week of use, my pores are visibly smaller. I need a moisturizer after using it because I have dry skin and live in a desert climate.

I am a sole believer in this face care line!!! After using the Fantastic Face Wash, my second step is using the face tonic, followed with their Vitamin C serum and then the Golden Hour Recovery Cream. I have found this skin care to be very clean and I have noticed a great improvement reducing my age spots and has improved the softness and texture of my skin. VERY PLEASED with this skincare line!!! I suggest you give it a try….
